reserveReview.rationale: BRL1's latest linked proof-of-reserves report discloses R$5,820,958.93 of LFTs, R$5,923.85 of bank balance, and R$929,250.86 of repos, or 86.16%, 0.09%, and 13.75% of the reported R$6,756,133.64 reserve. The May 2026 report is issuer-produced and not independently audited, so the exact composition retains probable confidence.
